I am a young mother here in Lilongwe with only a small piece of land, and maize is our food for the year, so I must try my best even when money is short. I will buy a little fertilizer if I can get the subsidy coupon, but not so much because the price is high, and I will put manure from our chickens and goats to help the soil. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year and I have no irrigation, so I rely on the rains and use some seed I kept, but this year I managed to get a small packet of improved seed from the agro-dealer. My husband and I will work the plot ourselves with help from my older children, and I will only hire one or two people for weeding when the maize is knee-high.
